spec: §15 suite G (every §10 state transition); §10 waiting: waiting on a SUSPENDED, REVERSED or CLOSED run is E_INVALID_STATE; bennett_wait returns exactly one of HOST_REQUEST or a result
derivation: A suspended run has neither outcome available, so bennett_wait must return E_INVALID_STATE immediately rather than block; the one-shot CLI has no suspend/wait surface at all.
